CHAPTER 04 ✳

Leadership & Community Service

From creating a place to play to sharing science and building libraries, these are the moments and people behind my community work.

✳
Vice President

NextCent Innovation

Head of Expertise

STEMese

With STEMese, our work moves between the spaces children use and the things they can discover together. The story begins with a place to play, then continues through hands-on science and learning.

President

Light of Book

Through Light of Book, I carry that same commitment into our library projects. Collecting books is only the beginning: together, we prepare the space, install equipment, and spend time learning with the children who will use it.

Service over time

Earlier community experiences

These projects are part of a longer connection to community service, shaped by visits with my family and time spent listening to people in very different circumstances.
